'''6000''' ('''six thousand''') is the [[natural number]] following 5999 and preceding 6001.

==Selected numbers in the range 6001–6999==

===6001 to 6099===
* '''6028''' – [[centered heptagonal number]]<ref name=A069099>{{cite OEIS|A069099|Centered heptagonal numbers.}}</ref>
* '''6037''' – [[super-prime]]
* '''6047''' – [[safe prime]]
* '''6053''' – [[Sophie Germain prime]]
* '''6064''' – {{sfrac|6064|4813}} ≈ [[∛2]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=Continued Fractions and Characteristic Recurrences |url=https://www.mathpages.com/home/kmath434.htm |website=Math Pages}}</ref>
* '''6069''' – [[nonagonal number]]<ref name=A001106>{{cite OEIS|A001106|2=9-gonal (or enneagonal or nonagonal) numbers: a(n) = n*(7*n-5)/2.}}</ref>
* '''6073''' – [[balanced prime]]
* '''6084''' = 78<sup>2</sup>, sum of the cubes of the first twelve integers
* '''6081''' – sum of the first 54 primes
* '''6089''' – [[highly cototient number]]<ref>{{cite OEIS|A100827|Highly cototient numbers: records for a(n) in A063741.}}</ref>
* '''6095''' – [[magic constant]] of ''n'' × ''n'' normal [[magic square]] and [[Eight queens puzzle|n-Queens Problem]] for ''n'' = 23.
